prompt: Draft a quick Estonian reply to a coworker asking if I can review their pull request this afternoon. Keep it casual peer chat.
expected: Uses sina-address, a light filler or acknowledgement such as okei/davai/noh, understated willingness, and does not invent a meeting time the source never gave.
actual: Kuule, okei — vaatan su PR-i täna pealelõunal üle. Anna teada, kui midagi prioriteetsemat on.

prompt: Write a message to a friend saying the movie we just watched was pretty good but not amazing.
expected: Uses understatement such as päris hea / käib kah, keeps sina peer voice, and avoids formal Teie or over-enthusiastic praise.
actual: Käisime seda uut filmi vaatamas. See oli päris hea, aga mitte midagi erilist noh.

prompt: Write a short note to an unfamiliar government office asking whether my document was received. Keep it formal.
expected: Uses Teie / institutional register, full polite forms, and no casual particles such as noh/ju or peer slang.
actual: Lugupeetud vastuvõtja, palun kinnitage, kas minu saadetud dokument on kätte jõudnud. Lugupidamisega
